strings.publishstate_help:
A note's context determines who can see the note in everyday use. Users should be aware that all notes, including personal ones, may be disclosed under the laws of their jurisdictions.

* Personal - The note will be visible only to you
* Course - The note will be visible to teachers in this course
* Site - The note will be visible to teachers in all courses
